title: Reply All Guard
summary: Shows how many people a reply-all really reaches and who is outside the organisation before it goes, with a one-tap reply to the sender only.
description: Reply-all check: counts real reach with distribution lists expanded, names external recipients by domain, catches a BCC'd or forwarded-to reader about to reveal themselves and a Reply-To that points elsewhere, with sender-only or internal-only fixes and Undo.
catches: Real reach, with list member counts you supply
You were BCC'd or forwarded the mail, so reply-all would reveal you (not flagged when it came via a list you're on)
A Reply-To that points somewhere other than the sender
limits: List sizes and your list memberships come from props; it cannot expand lists itself
BCC detection infers from headers; unusual relays can cause misses or false alarms
Does not send; it changes the recipient set you pass on
a11y: Choice outcome announced in a polite live region
After a fix, focus moves to Undo; after Undo, back to the first fix or returnFocusRef
Fix options are plain buttons with text labels; icons are aria-hidden
stops: Reply all to the whole company
